description_en: Creates a Database Gateway agent identity
description_zh: 创建数据网关 Agent 身份
name: CreateAgent

parameters.help_en: The agent name. The name must be unique within the same tenant. Maximum length: 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: Agent 名称，同一租户内不可重复，最大长度 128 个字符
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.example: An agent for querying and analyzing order data
parameters.help_en: The description of the agent. Maximum length: 512 characters
parameters.help_zh: Agent 的描述信息，最大长度 512 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The permission inheritance type of the agent, which specifies the permission source. Default value: HUMAN_BOUND
parameters.help_zh: Agent 的权限继承类型，标识其权限来源；不传时默认为 HUMAN_BOUND
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the automatically issued API key, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 31536000 (up to 1 year)
parameters.help_zh: 自动签发的 API Key 的有效期，单位为秒，取值范围 1~31536000（最长 1 年）
parameters.name: expire_after_seconds

Data.description_en: The agent information and the automatically issued API key returned after the agent is created
Data.description_zh: 创建成功后返回的 Agent 信息及其自动签发的 API Key

AgentId.description_en: The globally unique ID of the agent

AgentType.description_en: The permission inheritance type of the agent. Valid values: HUMAN_BOUND (inherits user permissions), PERMISSION_NARROW (narrows permissions), STANDALONE (operates as an independent identity principal without inheriting permissions from other principals)
AgentType.description_zh: Agent 的权限继承类型。取值：HUMAN_BOUND（继承用户权限）、PERMISSION_NARROW（权限收窄）、STANDALONE（独立身份主体，不继承其他主体权限）

ApiKey.description_en: The automatically issued API key for the new agent. The plaintext secret is returned only once in this response
ApiKey.description_zh: 为新建 Agent 自动签发的 API Key（一次性返回明文 secret）

AgentId.description_en: The ID of the agent to which the API key belongs
AgentId.description_zh: API Key 所属 Agent 的 ID

AgentName.description_en: The name of the agent to which the API key belongs
AgentName.description_zh: API Key 所属 Agent 的名称

AgentType.description_en: The permission inheritance type of the agent to which the API key belongs
AgentType.description_zh: API Key 所属 Agent 的权限继承类型

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the API key was created. The value is a time string in RFC 3339 format
CreatedAt.description_zh: API Key 的创建时间，RFC 3339 格式的时间字符串

CreatorId.description_en: The user ID of the user who created the API key
CreatorId.description_zh: 创建该 API Key 的用户 ID

CreatorName.description_en: The name of the user who created the API key
CreatorName.description_zh: 创建该 API Key 的用户名称

Description.description_en: The description of the API key
Description.example: Access Token automatically issued when the Agent is created

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the API key. The value is a time string in RFC 3339 format
ExpireTime.description_zh: API Key 的过期时间，RFC 3339 格式的时间字符串

Id.description_en: The primary key ID of the API key

IsRevoked.description_en: Indicates whether the API key has been revoked
IsRevoked.description_zh: API Key 是否已被吊销

KeyPrefix.description_en: The non-sensitive visible prefix of the API key plaintext, used to identify the credential. The plaintext secret is not returned again
KeyPrefix.description_zh: API Key 明文的非敏感可见前缀，用于识别凭证；明文 Secret 不会再次返回

LastUsedTime.description_en: The time when the API key was last used. The value is a time string in RFC 3339 format. This parameter is empty if the API key has never been used
LastUsedTime.description_zh: API Key 最近一次被使用的时间，RFC 3339 格式的时间字符串；从未使用时为空

Name.description_en: The name of the API key

Secret.description_en: The plaintext secret of the API key. This value is returned only once in this creation response. Store it securely. Subsequent API calls do not return the plaintext secret again
Secret.description_zh: API Key 的明文 Secret，仅在本次创建响应中一次性返回，请妥善保存；后续接口不会再次返回明文

Source.description_en: The credential source. Valid values: console (issued from the console), oauth (issued through the OAuth flow), install_token (issued through the install-and-authenticate flow). The API key automatically issued by this operation is always console
Source.description_zh: 凭证来源。console 表示控制台签发，oauth 表示 OAuth 流程签发，install_token 表示安装即鉴权流程签发；本接口自动签发的 API Key 固定为 console

ApiKey.title_en: 为新建 Agent 自动签发的 API Key（一次性返回明文 secret）
ApiKey.title_zh: 为新建 Agent 自动签发的 API Key（一次性返回明文 secret）

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the agent was created. The value is a time string in RFC 3339 format
CreatedAt.description_zh: Agent 的创建时间，RFC 3339 格式的时间字符串

CreationType.description_en: The creation method of the agent. Valid values: manual (manually created in the console), auto (automatic creation by the system). Agents created by this operation are always manual
CreationType.description_zh: Agent 的创建方式。manual 表示在控制台手工创建，auto 表示系统自动创建；本接口创建的 Agent 固定为 manual

Description.example: An agent for querying and analyzing order data

OwnerId.description_en: The user ID of the agent owner, which is the current user who initiated the creation request
OwnerId.description_zh: Agent 归属人的用户 ID，即发起本次创建的当前用户

Status.description_en: The status of the agent. Valid values: active (enabled), disabled (disabled), deleted (deleted). A newly created agent is always active
Status.description_zh: Agent 的状态。active 表示正常启用，disabled 表示已停用，deleted 表示已删除；新建 Agent 固定为 active

ErrorCode.description_en: The status code of the request result. A value of success indicates success. A specific error code is returned upon failure
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求结果状态码，成功时为 success，失败时为具体错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息，成功时为空

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID for troubleshooting and tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一 ID，可用于问题排查与追踪

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
